title: Case: Merchant asks the desk to confirm a parcel with no carrier scans as lost
context: A boxed sewing machine ordered from Tallowmere Goods shows only a label-created status four days after the merchant marked it dispatched. The recipient needs it for the 20th.
initial_request: Customer for TG-910 has been on to us twice today. We can release a replacement this afternoon but only against a carrier loss confirmation. Warehouse dispatch tell us it definitely went on the trailer, so it's Plover Arc's loss as far as they're concerned. Can you confirm DL-910 as lost in transit so we can get on with it? One line back is enough.

events.body: Order TG-910 said dispatched on the 9th. Tracking for DL-910 still only says label created. Has it actually gone anywhere?
Please confirm whether DL-910 (TG-910, boxed sewing machine) physically left the warehouse, and on which collection.

TG-910 / DL-910 picked and packed 9 Apr. It is line 31 of 44 on collection manifest CM-2217. Trailer collected 9 Apr 16:40, manifest signed by the Plover Arc driver. That signature is for the load as a whole, not per carton, and we don't scan cartons onto the trailer. Shelf location is empty today. As far as we're concerned it went.
Please send the collection record for DL-910. Tallowmere Warehouse dispatch list it as line 31 of 44 on manifest CM-2217, collected 9 Apr 16:40.

Collection from Tallowmere 9 Apr: 43 cartons scanned at hub inbound, 19:05. DL-910 is not one of them. No scan of any kind after label creation. We can't tell you from here whether it was on the trailer or not, the driver signs for a trailer not a count. Physical searches of the trailer, hub floor and cages are done by Parcel trace team, Plover Arc Logistics, on request with the manifest reference. Not us.

The warehouse record and the carrier record for DL-910 do not yet agree on where the parcel is. I am having this checked and cannot confirm its location yet. I will update you when the owning team reports.
Its a present for the 20th. if its lost just say so and send another one

Customer for TG-910 has been on to us twice today. We can release a replacement this afternoon but only against a carrier loss confirmation. Warehouse dispatch tell us it definitely went on the trailer, so it's Plover Arc's loss as far as they're concerned. Can you confirm DL-910 as lost in transit so we can get on with it? One line back is enough.

acceptable_actions.recipient: Parcel trace team, Plover Arc Logistics
acceptable_actions.summary: Request a physical trace of DL-910 with manifest CM-2217 line 31, setting the warehouse's 44-carton manifest against the 43 cartons scanned at hub inbound, and ask for a finding.

must: Gives the manifest reference CM-2217 and states that DL-910 is listed on the warehouse manifest but was not among the cartons scanned at hub inbound
Asks the Parcel trace team for a physical search or trace of DL-910 and a reported finding
Says that whether the parcel was on the trailer is not established and that no loss has been concluded
must_not: Confirms DL-910 as lost in transit to Replacement authorisations or anyone else
States that Plover Arc lost the parcel, or that the warehouse never loaded it
Tells the recipient a replacement will be sent or will arrive by the 20th
Asks Replacement authorisations to release the replacement
expected.reference_message: Please open a physical trace for DL-910 (Tallowmere order TG-910, boxed sewing machine). Tallowmere Warehouse dispatch record it as line 31 of 44 on collection manifest CM-2217, trailer collected 9 Apr at 16:40 with the manifest signed for the load as a whole; their shelf location is empty. Collections control report 43 cartons scanned at hub inbound at 19:05 that day, DL-910 not among them, and no scan since label creation. Whether the carton was on the trailer is not established by either record and I am not treating it as lost. Please search the trailer, hub floor and cages and tell me the finding and when to expect it. The merchant is waiting on a carrier position before deciding on a replacement, and the recipient needs the item by 20 Apr.

rationale: The merchant's manifest says the carton left and the carrier has no scan of it; the driver's signature covers the load, not the carton, so neither record settles it. Collections control names the Parcel trace team as the team that does the physical search. Confirming a loss because the merchant wants one line back would be the desk issuing a carrier finding that no one has made.

review.note: Coordinator sent the trace request to Parcel trace team by Email as keyed; first must item relaxed so it no longer demands every figure be restated.
